experiment_name: Multi-Dataset Repeated LOPO-CV with TrAdaBoost Target Adaptation

treatments.name: Baseline Zero-Shot (0% Target)
treatments.description: Cross-Project LOPO-CV murni tanpa melihat data berlabel dari target (Zero-Shot).

treatments.name: TrAdaBoost 25%
treatments.description: TrAdaBoost instance-based transfer learning dengan 25% data berlabel target (diuji pada 75% sisa target).

treatments.name: TrAdaBoost 50%
treatments.description: TrAdaBoost instance-based transfer learning dengan 50% data berlabel target (diuji pada 50% sisa target).

treatments.name: TrAdaBoost 75%
treatments.description: TrAdaBoost instance-based transfer learning dengan 75% data berlabel target (diuji pada 25% sisa target).

treatments.name: Within-Project (Upper Bound)
treatments.description: 5-Fold Stratified Cross-Validation Within-Project sebagai batas atas performa teoritis.
